name: Human-humanoid orchestrator benchmark
summary: Evaluates language-model orchestrators controlling a humanoid over MCP against five ISO 10218-2 invariants in 100-turn sessions, and measures drift in rule adherence.
numbers: 40 sessions × 100 turns; physical Unitree G1 layer announced, text layer reported

why.xr: Rule drift over long horizons is a weak controllability signal; harm is bounded.
